A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LeMiCa work. Their complete main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A-H are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original video-generation comparisons, ablations, OOD evaluations and Qwen-Image experiments, including Tables 1-3, 6 and 8.

after.justification: v3 retains the original video experiments and supplementary analyses and reports revised Qwen-Image measurements in Table 8.

M1.justification: The global-error DAG construction, budget-constrained lexicographic minimax optimization and inference procedure are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A, including Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions retain T2V-CompBench, VBench and IP-VBench, the same video-generation scenarios, and the Qwen-Image text-to-image extension. No dataset, task or represented domain is added or removed.

E2.justification: The Qwen-Image comparison in Table 8 removes 30%-step sampling, TeaCache and DBCache+TS. It retains the Cache-DiT family already represented by DBCache in v1, with revised configurations. Comparator sets in the video experiments remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Table 8 replaces the reported DBCache settings Fn8/Bn0/r0.6 and Fn4/Bn2/r1.5 with Cache-DiT settings F4W4R0.32, F1W8R0.8 and F1W4R0.8. The 50-step reference, LeMiCa budgets B=17 and B=10, and metric set remain. Further protocol changes or reruns are not documented.

E4.justification: The quality-latency, sample-size, trajectory, path-selection and resolution/length analyses in Section 4.3 are unchanged, as are Appendix C's OOD tests and the qualitative examples. Table 8 remains a benchmark comparison.

E5.justification: Both versions report ten repetitions with different seeds in Section 4.1 and twenty repetitions for the sample-size study in Section 4.3. No uncertainty-reporting or statistical-estimation procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Results change within the supplementary Qwen-Image comparison. Table 8's original-model ImageReward/CLIPScore changes from 1.18/33.63 to 1.196/35.116; LeMiCa B=17 PSNR changes from 27.92 to 34.326. Comparator entries and rankings also change, including Cache-DiT exceeding B=17 on ImageReward. Unexplained shared-row revisions prevent interpreting these as same-setting gains. Tables 1-7 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1-5, the formal optimization formulation and Appendix A's algorithm are unchanged. Figure 1's timestep-label correction does not alter mathematical assumptions, definitions or reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same central claims about training-free global cache scheduling and speed/fidelity improvements, including the Latte speedup and Open-Sora LPIPS examples.

C2.justification: Appendix F narrows its interpretation from consistently outperforming TeaCache and DBCache across qualitative and quantitative metrics to competitive visual-perception performance against Cache-DiT. The mechanism explanations and Appendix G limitations retain their substance.

D1.justification: Appendix D newly discloses that parallel offline edge-weight estimation used eight GPUs; v1 only described it as parallelizable. This documents existing experiments without establishing a hardware change. The reported offline costs and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography are unchanged, with Cache-DiT already cited as reference 42. Appendix F modestly revises positioning relative to that work by replacing broad superiority with competitive performance.

P1.justification: Editing is localized to Appendices D and F and the author block, which adds a corresponding-author marker and corrects an email identifier. The section sequence and broader narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 8 is shortened and regrouped, its caption changes, and its DBCache/TS footnote disappears. The resulting reflow places all of Appendix G on page 21. Figure 1 corrects a repeated x_(T-1) node label to x_(T-2); no figure is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 improves transparency through the eight-GPU disclosure and better calibrates Appendix F's interpretation to its mixed results. However, Table 8 narrows comparator coverage and changes even the original-model and LeMiCa scores without explaining why. These competing effects make the net quality impact uncertain, while the core method and video evidence remain unchanged.
